mapper.sql: id AS "id", run_id AS "runId", window_key AS "windowKey", error_code AS "errorCode", node_key AS "nodeKey", strategy AS "strategy", default_action AS "defaultAction", allowed_actions::text AS "allowedActions", decision_reason AS "decisionReason", status AS "status", opened_at::text AS "openedAt", timeout_at::text AS "timeoutAt", decided_at::text AS "decidedAt", decided_by AS "decidedBy", decided_action AS "decidedAction", note AS "note"
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO manual_window (tenant_id, run_id, window_key, error_code, node_key, strategy, default_action, allowed_actions, decision_reason, status, timeout_at) SELECT #{tenantId}, #{runId}, #{windowKey}, #{errorCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{nodeKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{strategy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{defaultAction}, #{allowedActionsJson}::jsonb, #{reason}, 'pending', now() + make_interval(mins => #{timeoutMinutes}) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM manual_window WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND window_key = #{windowKey} AND status = 'pending' )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM manual_window WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY opened_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM manual_window WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND window_key = #{windowKey} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE manual_window SET status = 'decided', decided_at = now(), decided_by = #{decidedBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, decided_action = #{decidedAction}, note = #{note, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'pending' AND decided_at IS NULL
UPDATE manual_window SET status = 'timed_out' WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'pending' AND timeout_at IS NOT NULL AND timeout_at <= now()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM manual_window WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND window_key LIKE #{prefix}
